records.process_description: The page directs students to the unit’s Merkblatt Bachelorarbeit (PDF) for all information on planning, supervision, booking and submission deadlines; additional, chair- or specialization-specific Merkblätter are available for more detailed rules. Eligibility is not specified on this page. Bachelor theses must be submitted to the supervising person by 1 December (autumn semester) or 1 June (spring semester). You must register yourself for graduation in the Studienfortschritt & -abschluss app within the Studiendekanat’s deadlines; registration is only possible once all required study credits have been obtained and entered in the system. Official rules and procedures live in the Merkblatt Bachelorarbeit, the specialization/Lehrstuhl Merkblätter and the Philosophical Faculty’s bachelor-completion information.
